StrengthSMP · Season 5Strength, abilities, and useful commands

Season 5 runs StrengthSMP. You start at 0 strength, with a range of −3 to +5. Your ability unlocks at 5 strength.

Starting strength0
Maximum strength5
Ability unlock5

Check your strength with /strength. Activate your ability with /ability, /sability, or /s. You can also triple-tap your sprint key.

Combat & gearNetherite tools, weapons, and cooldowns
Netherite tools & weapons are enabled

Build your loadout for Season 5. Lunge on spears is allowed.

Mace20 sec
Spear5 sec
Ender pearl15 sec

SpawnWorld PvP arena

Place and break blocks in the PvP arena. The arena resets daily.

Lootdrops, KOTH & OP bossesRTP rewards and fights worth preparing for
  • RTP lootdrops: Lootdrops are in the RTP world. Use /rtp to head out and explore.
  • KOTH: Capture and hold the zone for rewards. Use /warp koth.
  • OP bosses at KOTH: Bring your team and take on powerful bosses.
  • Piñatas & envoys: Join the events and race for loot.

Follow Discord announcements for event times.
